title: clematis recta subsp. terniflora
intro: Clematis recta subsp. terniflora, commonly known as Clematis terniflora, is a species of flowering plant in the buttercup family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce symptoms of conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Clematis terniflora include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion, and as an anti-inflammatory, reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of Clematis terniflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
